==Description==
'''Canister Throw''' is an emote obtained from the [[Ducky Revenge Event]] by triumphing [[Bathroom Approach]] on the Hard difficulty twice. The second triumph had to be done 64 hours after the first triumph. It was made by STEALTH_NOVA and Vylith. The emote is not looped, moveable or interactable. No music can be heard while performing this emote, but sounds can be heard while using it.

When performed, '''Canister Throw''' will make the player throw a canister on the ground, which will make a [[Sunflower]] grow on the area. It will last on the ground for 15 seconds. The [[Sunflower]] will face towards where the sun is.

==Trivia==
*The description for this emote is a reference to the notes left by the [[w:c:plantsvszombies:Zombies (PvZ)|Zombies]] in ''Plants vs Zombies''.
